name: LegalWeb Cloud
description: Integrates the legalweb.io cloud service for legal texts/consent.
project_description:
With this plugin, you can use the legalweb.io cloud service with your Drupal page. It connects to the legalweb.io web API and fetches your legal texts, terms & conditions and integrations to insert it in your Drupal Page.

 
 update the module As there are API Changes, please update to the v2 version of the Module.

 
 Back to top 

 All-in-one solution 
 As a user of LegalWeb Cloud you have two simple tasks:

 
 Selection of the services used 
 Filling of a few input fields 
 
 Back to top 

 LegalWeb Cloud does everything else: 
 
 Creation of the consent popup 
 Creation of the "cookie"/services notice 
 Control of services 
 Control of embeddings 
 Generation of the data protection information 
 Creation of the imprint 
 
 

 Back to top 

 Top Priority 
 Our top priority is compliance with the laws and the regulations of courts and of data protection authorities . We do not offer options that are not legally or legally highly controversial.

 LAWYER CREATED 
All legal texts were created by the law firm Marketingrecht.eu, which specializes in IT, internet and data protection law.

 TCF Certified 

Your Drupal Website is ready to server Google ADs .

 TRANSLATED BY COURT INTERPRETERS 

All translations have been translated by sworn and certified interpreters. 

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 optimized for Germany & Austria 
 can also be used in other EU countries and third countries 
 Tag Manager compatible 
 
 Back to top 

 Imprint 
 
 Automatic creation 
 Integration via block, a page or token 
 (from cloud version: significantly expanded imprint generator) 
 
 Back to top 

 Cookie Popup / Cookie Notice / Privacy Info 
 
 Our feature list gets longer and longer every month. 
 Opt-in / consent management 
 Opt-out / cancellation management 
 definable validity of consent 
 definable waiting time until the new request for consent 
 correct grouping of services 
 Display of all mandatory information 
 No illegal nudging (obtaining consent through psychotricks) 
 
 
 Important note: This plugin only supports you in fulfilling the guidelines for compliance with the GDPR. Installation is not enough – correct configuration of this plugin by a website administrator is required to achieve conformity. A 100% conformity only through the plugin cannot be guaranteed, as this depends on several other aspects.

 Back to top 

 Enhancements Submodule 
 Activate the Submodule legalweb_cloud_enhancements to adjust the behavior of the widget:

 
 Click outside the popup-window will not close the dialog. 
 Remove "close" button from popup so people have one option less to decline. 
 If privacy service options are selected, the button label will be adjusted to "Accept selection" or "Accept nothing" instead of 3 buttons by default 
 LegalWeb script can be put to the HTML head if content blocker is not working otherwise.
